CTools: Pentaho Community Tools — a stack of open-source plugins installed on top of the Pentaho Server for building interactive dashboards: CDA, CDF, CDE, CCC, and CGG.
CDA: Community Data Access — the data layer for CTools dashboards. An abstraction over many data sources (SQL, MDX, Kettle, scripting…) with parameter-driven queries, joins/unions, preview, caching, and exports, exposing dashboard-ready datasets.
CDF: Community Dashboard Framework — the code-first dashboard framework. Build dashboards with HTML/CSS/JavaScript while CDF manages the dashboard and component lifecycles; CDE is built on top of it.
CDE: Community Dashboard Editor — the graphical dashboard editor (a Pentaho Server plugin). Build dashboards through a Layout → Components → Data Sources workflow over the CDF framework, with little or no hand-coding.
CCC: Community Chart Components (CCC2) — the CTools charting library, built on Protovis/SVG. Provides flexible, interactive charts (bar, line, pie, etc.) with ~200 properties plus extension points, added via the CDE Components perspective.
CGG: Community Graphics Generator — renders CCC charts server-side as images. Used for charts in Pentaho reports, for browsers with limited SVG support, and to render a chart via a URL.
Dashboard: An interactive page combining components (charts, tables, selectors) wired to data sources and parameters, built with CDF or CDE and viewed in the Pentaho User Console.
Component: A JavaScript object in a dashboard that links a layout element to data — charts, tables, selectors, parameters, and scripts. Components have a lifecycle (preExecution → update → postExecution) and react to parameter changes.
Parameter: A value shared across components. Set by input/selector components and read by others via Listeners; when a parameter changes, every component listening to it updates — the basis of dashboard interactivity.
Listener: A component property naming the dashboard parameters that trigger the component to re-run. Listeners enable interaction and control execution order between components.
HtmlObject: A component property holding the id of the HTML layout element (column) the component renders into — it ties a component to a place in the layout.
Layout: The CDE perspective and structure defining a dashboard's appearance with rows and columns (HTML/CSS). With Bootstrap, a row's columns must sum to 12 spans.
Perspective: One of the CDE editor views — Layout, Components, Data Sources, and Preview — switched from the toolbar in the top-right of the editor.
Bootstrap layout: CDE's responsive grid: columns in a row must total 12 spans (e.g. 8+4, 3x4), with per-device widths (phone/tablet/desktop) so dashboards adapt across screen sizes.
Data Sources perspective: The CDE view where you define the queries that feed components — CDA, SQL, MDX, OLAP4J, Kettle, Scripting, Compound, MQL, and XPath data sources.
Preview: The CDE perspective/action that renders the dashboard as you build so you can test its look, feel, and behaviour without leaving the editor.
xcdf: The dashboard definition file for a CDF dashboard — an XML file (title, author, template, style, require) that points to the dashboard's HTML template.
wcdf: The dashboard descriptor for a CDE dashboard (the CDE counterpart of the .xcdf), created and managed through the CDE interface.
RequireJS: The AMD module loader CDF/CDE can use to load dashboard dependencies. Enabling RequireJS support changes how component and library code is declared and loaded.
Query: A named data request defined in CDA (or a CDE data source) that returns a result set for components. CDA queries can take parameters and be combined via joins/unions.
doQuery: The CDA HTTP endpoint that runs a query and returns its result set (e.g. as JSON) — used by dashboard components and for testing a CDA file.
CDA API: The set of CDA HTTP endpoints (doQuery, listParameters, getCdaList, previewQuery, editFile…) for running queries, listing parameters, and managing CDA files programmatically.
Cache: CDA can cache query results to speed up dashboards. Cached queries are managed (and cleared) via the Cache Manager, important when underlying data changes.
Compound query: A CDA query that combines the results of two other queries with a JOIN or a UNION, letting a dashboard component consume data assembled from multiple sources.
Scripting query: A CDA data source that builds ad-hoc result sets with a Beanshell script — handy for prototyping data without a database.
Selector: An input component (drop-down, radio, date picker, list…) that lets the user pick a value, which it stores in a parameter to filter the rest of the dashboard.
Chart component: A CCC2-based visualization component (CCC Pie/Line/Bar/etc.) added in the Components perspective and bound to a CDA query and an HtmlObject.
Protovis: The open-source, SVG-based JavaScript visualization toolkit CCC is built on. Advanced chart customization beyond CCC properties is done via Protovis extension points.
Extension point: A CCC2 mechanism to set Protovis properties not exposed as standard CCC options, named `<element>_<property>` (e.g. xAxisLabel_textAngle) — for fine-grained chart customization.
Priority: A component property controlling execution order on load — lower numbers run first (default 5). Use it when one component must run before another.
Execute at Start: A component property (default True) controlling whether the component runs when the dashboard loads, or only when a listened parameter changes.
preExecution / postExecution: Lifecycle functions run before/after a component initialises, updates, or renders. preExecution returning false skips the update; postExecution tweaks the result.
postFetch: A component function that receives the data returned by its query before rendering — used to reshape or post-process the result set.
Mock-up: A sketch of the intended dashboard (layout, components, interactions) produced during the design/First Steps phase, before building it in CDE.
Functional breakdown: Decomposing a dashboard's requirements into its data, layout, and component pieces during design — clarifying what each part must do before building.
Pentaho User Console: The browser-based home of the Pentaho Server (PUC, http://localhost:8080) where CTools dashboards are created (New CDE Dashboard), edited, and run.
Enable CDE & CDA: The one-time setup that uncomments plugin entries in pentaho-cdf-dd's plugin.xml and settings.xml (then restarts the server) so the New CDE Dashboard option appears in PUC.
Carrier Dashboard: The course's running CDE example — a logistics/carrier dashboard built progressively: responsive layout, CCC charts and selectors driven by CDA queries, then CGG-rendered chart images.
Steel Wheels / SampleData: The sample database the dashboards query (via CDA SQL/MDX) — the fictional model-car company's orders, products, customers, and time data.
